title: Coherent reductions from strict coefficient systems
statement: Let B be an inverse sequence of commutative ring sheaves on a coefficient-universe-small site. Fix a scalar assignment S and normalized ordinary and derived tensor coherence D as in the system-level theory. For any additive functor F from an abelian category A to StrictRingSystem B preserving finite limits and finite colimits, with an ordinary derived category for A, the tensor adjuncts of the actual strict transitions define ordinary reduction natural transformations. The scalar comparison, termwise ordinary reduction and evaluation localization comparisons descend to derived reduction natural transformations. Their value on every complex is the specified comparison formula. Identity reductions are the normalized derived tensor unit, and successive reductions equal direct reduction under the normalized derived tensor associator.

proof.text: Transposition under the scalar adjunction gives ordinary reduction. Adjunction naturality gives its naturality square. Injectivity of the adjunction maps reduces identity and composition to unit tensors; the normalized unitor and associator formulas and the strict transition equations give the result.

source.place: Coefficient-tower lemma, clauses (1)--(3); Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.3; Stacks 06YS and 06XN

proof.text: To extend the normalized scalar comparisons from K-flat complexes with flat terms to every complex, choose a flat-term K-flat resolution at a single coefficient level. Convert flatness by the sheaf tensor comparison. Naturality and cancellation of the inverted quasi-isomorphism extend equality of the transformations.

source.place: Coefficient-tower lemma, clauses (1)--(3); Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.5.3; Stacks 06YS and 06XN

proof.text: For an exact presentation F, compose the evaluation comparison, scalar comparison, ordinary reduction on complexes, and inverse evaluation comparison. Both endpoint functors factor through derived localization. The localization lifting theorem descends this natural transformation and proves its value on every complex.

proof.text: Check the derived unit and composition laws by localization extensionality. Cancel evaluation comparison isomorphisms; use naturality, the all-complex scalar coherence just proved, and the ordinary reduction equations. These are equations of the actual canonical tensor comparison maps.

theorem presentedDerivedReduction_comp {r m n : ℕ} (h : r ≤ m) (k : m ≤ n)
    (M : DerivedCategory A) :
    (systemDerivedTensor S B h).map ((presentedDerivedReduction S B F k).app M) ≫
        (presentedDerivedReduction S B F h).app M =
      (D.derivedAssoc B h k).hom.app
          ((F ⋙ systemEvaluation B n).mapDerivedCategory.obj M) ≫
        (presentedDerivedReduction S B F (h.trans k)).app M
